question: Should the repository adopt the newer gh-aw action set through a deliberate compiler upgrade, or retain the current v0.72.1-generated workflow assets?
rationale: The correct action revision depends on the gh-aw compiler release selected for this repository; the PR does not establish that upgrade decision or regenerate the companion assets.

options.title: Retain the current generated pin
options.body: Do not merge this standalone Dependabot update; retain the v0.72.1-compatible action revision until a planned gh-aw upgrade is prepared.

options.title: Upgrade gh-aw as a coordinated change
options.body: Select the target gh-aw release, run the supported regeneration command, and review the resulting coordinated workflow and action-pin changes together.

recommendation.title: Retain the current generated pin
recommendation.body: Do not merge this standalone Dependabot update; retain the v0.72.1-compatible action revision until a planned gh-aw upgrade is prepared.

likelyOwner.reason: Available repository history places this contributor near CI and dependency-maintenance work, but ownership should be confirmed by a human reviewer.
